body.message:
Hello, hope all is well.
All empty and moved out, keys are in this wood box on kitchen bench.

We also just want to say thank you very very much for everything you guys have been amazing hosts and really fast to help us when we were in need. We will be telling our friends and family coming to Dubai to check in with you guys and use your amazing service.

Please let me know when you’ll be returning our deposit and what bank account to as I may of closed it and just want to double check before the deposit gets sent back and potentially to the wrong account. 

Best regards
